lexicon.L1: last explicitly mentioned A/C; B only updates destination
lexicon.T0: first explicitly mentioned A/C remains topic through record end
lexicon.identity_REUSE: repeated whole form reuses one local candidate; not observed individual identity
lexicon.identity_FRESH: each mention introduces a new instance of the same type
lexicon.reset: every record, including embedded Q1/Q2; no lookahead, image default or inherited argument
lexicon.destination: most recent explicit B in record; remains missing before first mention
lexicon.unknown_groups: conserved open; cannot change memory in this limited model, not claimed semantically empty

N: First occurrence of each material type activates it; later mentions never switch.
R: First material activates; different material switches only upon a repeated occurrence.
L1: Every material mention updates. P12 baseline.
boundaries: Activation/switch until next different activation or record end; B only destination; no unknown inferred marker.
